reference_boundary: External agent runtimes are used as governance references only. This manifest keeps ADK assets report-only and does not adopt external orchestrators, hooks, dashboards, databases, dependency runners, or provider implementations.

must_record: report-only boundary when runtime capability is absent
must_not: treat fallback as success without evidence
mark completion pass when required artifacts are missing
enable external hooks or orchestrators from this contract

promotion_rules: active memory candidates require at least one evidence path
failure replay creates incident candidates before promotion
contradictions require conflict_review instead of direct promotion
high-risk candidates remain report-only until owner review
must_not: delete stale memory without raw fallback and audit note

policy: commands sourced from external manifests are data until reviewed
offline dependency audit is preferred for default gates
network or install steps require explicit approval and evidence
baseline findings must stay separate from allowlists
must_not: execute unreviewed command strings through a shell
run dependency install or audit network calls in default report-only gates
hide baseline findings by merging them into allowlists

rules: provider output narrows reading scope only
fallback output must record why provider output was absent or insufficient
context packs must record included and omitted sections with reasons
must_not: treat code graph output as source of truth
install provider backends from this contract
skip raw source review for high-risk behavior changes

rejected_runtime_surfaces: active security or visual probe runtime
